scope: Research estimates at the first observed normal-cognition assessment in Parkinson disease

AGE_AT_VISIT.label: Age (years)
AGE_AT_VISIT.help: Age at the index normal-cognition assessment, in years.
AGE_AT_VISIT.range_basis: Observed development cohort range; continuous bounds rounded outward to 0.01

SEX.label: Male sex
SEX.help: Sex coded in the study dataset.
SEX.range_basis: Observed development cohort range; continuous bounds rounded outward to 0.01

EDUCYRS.label: Education (years)
EDUCYRS.range_basis: Observed development cohort range; continuous bounds rounded outward to 0.01

GBA_carrier.label: GBA1 carrier
GBA_carrier.help: Use the confirmed GBA1 carrier result; an unavailable result is not negative.
GBA_carrier.range_basis: Observed development cohort range; continuous bounds rounded outward to 0.01

NP2PTOT.label: MDS-UPDRS II total
NP2PTOT.range_basis: Observed development cohort range; continuous bounds rounded outward to 0.01

MCATOT.label: Montreal Cognitive Assessment
MCATOT.help: PPMI Montreal Cognitive Assessment total (MCATOT) at index.
MCATOT.range_basis: Observed development cohort range; continuous bounds rounded outward to 0.01

HVLT_total_learning.label: HVLT-R total learning
HVLT_total_learning.help: Sum of all three HVLT-R learning trials. A partial two-trial sum is not a total.
HVLT_total_learning.range_basis: Observed development cohort range; continuous bounds rounded outward to 0.01

LNS_TOTRAW.label: Letter-Number Sequencing
LNS_TOTRAW.range_basis: Observed development cohort range; continuous bounds rounded outward to 0.01

SDMTOTAL.label: Symbol Digit Modalities
SDMTOTAL.help: Symbol Digit Modalities Test total correct.
SDMTOTAL.range_basis: Observed development cohort range; continuous bounds rounded outward to 0.01

DVT_SFTANIM.label: Animal-fluency T score
DVT_SFTANIM.help: PPMI animal-fluency T score (DVT_SFTANIM), as defined by the harmonized dictionary. This is not a raw animal count; no raw-to-T-score conversion is provided.
DVT_SFTANIM.range_basis: Observed development cohort range; continuous bounds rounded outward to 0.01

NP1COG.label: Cognitive complaints
NP1COG.range_basis: Observed development cohort range; continuous bounds rounded outward to 0.01

RBDSQ_TOTAL.label: RBD questionnaire
RBDSQ_TOTAL.help: Complete REM Sleep Behavior Disorder Screening Questionnaire total, including its neurological-disease item.
RBDSQ_TOTAL.range_basis: Observed development cohort range; continuous bounds rounded outward to 0.01

SCAU_TOTAL.label: SCOPA-AUT total
SCAU_TOTAL.help: Complete SCOPA-AUT total: 21 common and two sex-specific items. Do not use a partial sum or count not-applicable responses as zero.
SCAU_TOTAL.range_basis: Observed development cohort range; continuous bounds rounded outward to 0.01

MSEADLG.label: Schwab-England ADL
MSEADLG.help: Schwab-England activities-of-daily-living score, as a percentage. Select the recorded score; choices reflect observed development values.
MSEADLG.range_basis: Observed development cohort range; continuous bounds rounded outward to 0.01

NP3TOT_analysis.label: MDS-UPDRS III total
NP3TOT_analysis.help: Complete MDS-UPDRS III sum from one OFF-medication or untreated examination at index.
NP3TOT_analysis.range_basis: Observed development cohort range; continuous bounds rounded outward to 0.01

NHY_analysis.label: Hoehn-Yahr stage
NHY_analysis.help: Hoehn-Yahr stage from the same OFF-medication or untreated examination.
NHY_analysis.range_basis: Observed development cohort range; continuous bounds rounded outward to 0.01

clinical_assessment_window: Index month or the preceding three months, inclusive; demographics, education, and germline status follow their study-specific definitions.
range_policy: Known values within the development ranges are required; no silent input imputation.
